content_units: Osaka–Taipei Flight Balance for Your Trip

For 2 adults with 1 checked bag each and a   total budget of $700  ,   Option A   is the best overall balance of price and convenience. It stays well under budget, is nonstop both ways, and includes bags.
Ranked Flight Options
Airline   Departure   Arrival   Duration   Stops   Fare
Option A   2026-10-14 09:00 AM   11:45 AM   2h45   Non-stop   USD 536 total
Option C   2026-10-14 10:30 AM   01:15 PM   2h45 outbound / longer return   1 stop return   USD 610 total
Option B   2026-10-14 08:20 AM   03:30 PM   7h10 outbound / 6h50 return   1 stop each way   USD 568 total with bags
1) Option A — Best overall
-   Total trip cost:     $536
-   Why it wins:   Cheapest effective nonstop option, bags included, shortest travel time, simplest airport experience.
-   Best for:   Leisure travelers who want a smooth trip without paying a premium.
2) Option C — Best comfort upgrade
-   Total trip cost:     $610
-   Why consider it:   Still under budget, bag included, plus seat selection included.
-   Tradeoff:   You pay   $74 more than A   and still have a stop on the return.
3) Option B — Lowest base fare, weak value after fees
-   Base fare:   $214/person =   $428 total
-   Bag fees:   $35 each direction × 2 adults × 2 directions =   $140
-   Total trip cost:     $568
-   Tradeoff:   Only   $32 more than A   after bags, but with much longer travel time and a stop both ways.
Price vs Convenience Tradeoffs
-   Option A vs B:
A is only   $32 cheaper overall   once baggage is added to B, while saving roughly   8+ hours of total travel time   across the trip and avoiding 2 connections.
-   Option A vs C:
C gives seat selection and may be worth it if that matters a lot, but for a leisure trip A is the stronger value because it is   $74 cheaper   and more convenient overall.
-   Option B vs C:
C costs   $42 more   than B but is notably better on convenience, especially with a nonstop outbound and included seats/bag.
Best Pick for Your Priorities
Recommended: Option A
It best matches your stated priorities in order:
-   Price:   well within the   $700 total budget
-   Convenience:   nonstop both ways
-   Baggage:   included for both travelers
-   Overall value:   lowest hassle for nearly the lowest total cost
If you want a simple rule:
- Choose   A   for best overall value
- Choose   C   only if included seat selection is important enough to justify the extra cost
- Skip   B   unless schedule timing is dramatically better than the others
